rank_method: Ranked by latest known Elo on each match date. Teams inactive for more than 6 years at that date are excluded.
expected_wdl_method: Elo expected score converted into win/draw/loss using a Test cricket draw-rate curve. Draw probability starts around 28% for evenly matched teams and falls as the Elo gap increases.
score_method: Score field uses Cricsheet outcome margin text rather than innings-by-innings scorecards.
